# netbox_power_outlet_templates (Data Source)

Lists power_outlet_template objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_power_outlet_templates" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-power_outlet_template" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: feed_leg, feed_leg__empty, feed_leg__ic, feed_leg__ie, feed_leg__iew, feed_leg__iregex, feed_leg__isw, feed_leg__n, feed_leg__nic, feed_leg__nie, feed_leg__niew, feed_leg__nisw, feed_leg__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, module_type_id, module_type_id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, type, type__empty, type__ic, type__ie, type__iew, type__iregex, type__isw, type__n, type__nic, type__nie, type__niew, type__nisw, type__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `power_outlet_templates` (Attributes List) The matching power_outlet_templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--power_outlet_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--power_outlet_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `power_outlet_templates`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `feed_leg` (String) Phase of the upstream feed this outlet is mapped to. One of: A, B, C.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `module_type_id` (Number) Id of the module type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `name` (String)
- `power_port_id` (Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of power_port_template_id.
- `power_port_template_id` (Number) Id of the power port template this outlet draws from.
- `type` (String) Outlet type as its NetBox slug, e.g. iec-60320-c13, nema-5-15r, CS8364C (any of NetBox's power outlet type choices).
- `url` (String)
